headline: 申請加薪
brief:
# 社畜地獄 EP4〈申請加薪〉

## 故事前提

阿金深呼吸、敲門要談加薪。喵總不坐大皮椅，整隻擠在辦公桌上一個小紙箱裡。阿金舉起畫著長條圖的報告、眼睛水汪汪；喵總慢慢沉進紙箱，只剩兩隻耳朵。隔天，阿金的椅子上放著一個綁紅色蝴蝶結的大紙箱——這就是他的「加薪」，他坐在裡面打電腦。最後，那個紙箱裡坐的換成了喵總。

## 角色

- 阿金（ajin）、喵總（miaozong）：同系列定裝照。

## 站主觀點

零台詞；貓的天性：紙箱（對貓來說紙箱就是最高獎賞，而且好紙箱一定會被老闆搶走）。

## 格式

- 9:16，約 15 秒；Colab 首格與 H3 片段。

## 大綱

### 選項 A：申請加薪
一行說明：敲門 → 老闆擠在紙箱裡 → 舉報告、水汪汪 → 老闆沉進紙箱 → 隔天的加薪是一個紙箱 → 紙箱被老闆搶走。
開場鉤子：大皮椅空著，胖橘貓老闆擠在桌上的小紙箱裡。

shots.ff: Medium shot of A-Jin the Golden Retriever himself standing in front of a glass office door in his white shirt and crooked tie, holding a plain folder against his chest, taking a deep nervous breath.
shots.clip: The Golden Retriever shown in <Picture 1> takes a deep breath, straightens his tie, and knocks on the glass door three times with one knuckle. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of a boss's office: Boss Miao the orange tabby cat himself is squeezed inside a small cardboard box sitting on top of his big wooden desk, his grey suit jacket bulging over the edges, only his head and shoulders sticking out; his big black leather chair stands empty behind him.
shots.clip: The cat shown in <Picture 1> stares at the camera from inside the cardboard box with half-closed eyes, then slowly blinks once. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium close-up of A-Jin the Golden Retriever himself holding up a sheet of paper with a simple hand-drawn rising bar chart with no words or numbers, big hopeful puppy eyes.
shots.clip: The Golden Retriever shown in <Picture 1> holds up the bar chart, points eagerly at the tallest bar, and gives big pleading puppy eyes, tail wagging. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of Boss Miao the orange tabby cat himself inside the small cardboard box on his big wooden desk, only his head sticking out, expressionless.
shots.clip: The cat shown in <Picture 1> slowly sinks down into the cardboard box until only his two ears stick out over the edge; the ears twitch once. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of A-Jin's grey office desk the next morning: A-Jin the Golden Retriever himself sits squeezed inside a big cardboard box placed on his office chair, a big red gift bow stuck on the front of the box, a laptop on his knees with its screen facing away, a confused but polite smile.
shots.clip: The Golden Retriever shown in <Picture 1> sits in the box and types on the laptop; he glances down at the red bow, then back up at the camera with a confused polite smile. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of the same grey office desk: Boss Miao the orange tabby cat himself sits inside the big cardboard box with the red gift bow on the office chair, completely relaxed, eyes half closed; at the edge of the frame a golden retriever paw holds a laptop.
shots.clip: The cat shown in <Picture 1> settles deeper into the box with a contented look, slowly closes his eyes and curls his tail over the edge. The camera holds a static shot.
